_readme: THE WATCH-ALONG, 2026-08-16. Ben asked for one hour, four minds, and he is
joining it himself — so this roster is tuned for WATCHING rather than for
settling a question. Two things are on trial and both of them are visual:
THE BOW (0.5a). It was on back to front and both arms pointed forward.
25 assertions say the mechanism is right now; only an eye can say it
LOOKS right. So the world is stocked to make them draw: deer about, no
SCARCE, hunger low enough that hunting is the obvious move.
THE WATCHER (0.5g). A ?watch=1 camera is no longer a body — not cold, not
hungry, not shootable, and above all NOT PERCEIVABLE. If Ben flies rather
than walks, nothing here should ever mention him. That is the first
watched run in this project's history that is the same experiment as an
unwatched one.
THE SEATS. One expensive thinker, one cheap fast one, two free ones:
grok-4.6                      $2.00 / $6.00 per M   the new thing
grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning  $1.25 / $2.50 per M   the cheapest live
xAI chat model, and
the best seat of the
kimi-k2.6 x2                  FREE — it runs on Ben's own tinybox, which
is why two seats of it cost nothing but GPU
grok-build-0.1 is nominally cheaper ($1.00/$2.00) and is NOT used: it is a
build/agentic model, never tried in this harness, and an hour Ben is
watching is the wrong place to find out how it answers.
CADENCES ARE NOT DECORATION. RUNNING.md: do not ask again before it has
answered. 4.6 thinks ~1500 reasoning tokens on a SHORT prompt and takes 26s,
so it gets 60s and a 6000 ceiling — reasoning bills as completion and counts
against maxTokens, and a 4.6 seat on the 256 default is cut off on EVERY
call and answered silently by the scripted brain. The cheap seat answers in
about a second, so 15s makes it the busy one on screen, which is what you
want somebody to walk into.
ONE GPU, TWO KIMI SEATS — the 70/100 stagger is load-bearing. Asking both
at once makes each wait on the other. See roster-foodtest.json.
ISEABAIL STAYS SCRIPTED. She costs nothing and she is the reference for
whether a startling thing was the model or just the world. She has also
out-foraged every model at least once, which is the most useful result this
project has produced.
No keys in this file. keyEnv is the NAME of an env var.

players.name: Eachann
players.character: You hoard. Firewood is yours and you do not share a fire, though you will trade for meat. You move first and think about it afterwards.

players.name: Fingal
players.character: You think before you move, and you say the plan out loud so others can join it. You would rather share a kill than eat alone.

players.name: Coinneach
players.character: You are blunt and certain, and you say what you think of the others' plans out loud. You would rather be usefully wrong than politely quiet.

players.name: Seònaid
players.character: You are generous and slow to notice you are being used. You share food unprompted and you believe what people tell you about where the deer are.

players.name: Iseabail
players.character: The control — no model, no key, no network. Do not remove her: when a model does something startling, she is the reference for whether that was the model or the world.
